$description: Keyling's look, shared by the dongle's Candy theme and the hub app. Design Tokens Format (DTCG): colors are sRGB hex.

accent.$description: Focus and headers without an app color

bluetooth-connected.$description: Bluetooth symbol while a phone is connected

app.$description: One color per on-device app, by the app id the dongle reports

led.$description: Status LED colors at full brightness (the dongle dims them). Patterns are described in the firmware.

advertising.$description: Slow pulse: waiting for the phone

connected.$description: Short glow when the phone connects

security-key.$description: Double blink: a security key request waits for a touch

eject-start.$description: Drive ejected: a sweep from this…

pill.$description: Status pills on the home screen (profile, Bluetooth and USB)

badge.$description: Fully round: site badges on security key prompts

tile-radius-ratio.$description: App tiles' corner radius as a share of the tile's size

site.$description: Site names on security key prompts: monospaced, every look-alike character distinct (OFL-1.1)
